note: PSNR is an extra diagnostic.  It is NOT one of the twelve pre-registered keys, it is not written into any run's metrics.json, and no criteria / publish / guards code was touched to produce it.
psnr_definition: PSNR = 10 * log10(1 / mse); mse 在 sRGB [0,1] 上逐像素逐通道算, 对 (3,H,W) 全部元素取均值.
psnr_note: MAX_I = 1.0 (no 8-bit quantisation, no clipping applied before the mse); the two arguments are the same composed Î and the same I* the dE00 column on the same row is computed from; reduction is over all 3*H*W elements; computed on the model's device, float() only after the reduction.
split: V_what normal-only, GT alpha, short side 512

psnr_undefined_rule: PSNR is reported as null and dropped from a column exactly when mse == 0, i.e. Î == I* element-wise.  That happens when a baseline's drawn / selected LUT is the sample's own lut_id, so the composed image is the target bit for bit.  The same rows have dE00 == 0.  No value is substituted for them.
repeat_aggregation: B2 / B3 carry n_repeats = 8 draws per sample.  The per-sample dE00 value is the mean over the 8 draws (the same aggregation criteria._repeat_column uses); the per-sample PSNR value is the mean over the draws whose PSNR is defined.  Both counts are recorded per run in psnr_undefined_counts.
